reserve_profile.summary: Western Union and Anchorage describe USDPT as fully backed by U.S.-dollar reserve assets; Anchorage also publishes a reserve-attestation page. Report-body figures and full historical allocation series are not normalized here.

redemption_profile.eligible_parties: Eligible Anchorage Digital Bank clients and supported Western Union program participants under current terms.
redemption_profile.retail_access: Consumer distribution may occur through Western Union channels, but unrestricted direct issuer redemption for every holder is not inferred.
redemption_profile.institutional_access: Issuer-side access is subject to Anchorage onboarding, compliance and program terms.
